phase-locking.obstruction: no oscillation: at 11 values of phe in [0, 8] every start settles on a stable state or does not become periodic
phase-locking.obstruction_short: no oscillation in the control range

write_points.kind: saddle-node (fold): a state appears or vanishes; written by a pulse past the threshold

unfoldings.kind_along_sweep: supercritical pitchfork: symmetric write; a small bias chooses the state

law.start_of_sweep: the unwritten branch followed back from the write point
law.reduction_not_slow: the drift along the slow manifold varies at the rate 0.886 at s = -0.983, against the relaxation 0.1 of the eliminated directions there (ratio 8.86, at or above 1): the one-coordinate reduction does not hold over the amplitudes the write crosses, and the law is the linear stage with the outcome map
